title: REQ · Documentation describes the handoff to devion workseed
summary: Backend README and handoff doc explain the frozen-contribution export
description: Context: backend/README.md contains only 'hello Worldseed' and no docs describe the handoff. The Export type in backend/internal/contribution/export.go defines JSON v1 with version, world_id, round_id and contributions[id, author, content, created_at], and the Exporter includes only frozen contributions in snapshot order. Desired behavior: the docs say Worldseed collects contributions and hands frozen ones to devion workseed, which develops the game, and they document the format. Why: contributors and operators need to know where development happens.
acceptance_criteria: Given backend/README.md, when it is read, then it says Worldseed holds the game, contribution intake and round lifecycle, and that development is done by devion workseed

Given backend/docs/handoff.md, when it is read, then it documents the keys version, world_id, round_id, contributions, id, author, content and created_at and states that only frozen contributions are exported
Given the docs, when they are read, then they contain no mention of worker, ExecutionPanel, Claude Code or Cursor
technical_constraints: The documented format must match export.go exactly
The docs must not claim a CLI or API for export that does not exist
definition_of_done: Both docs are written and match the export type
